after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student

# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by name.

    Raises ValueError for an empty list, or for a student
    with no email (the message names that student).
    """
    roster = sorted(
        students,
        key=lambda item: (item.display_name.casefold(),
                          item.student_id)
    )
    if not roster:
        raise ValueError("no students to list")
    for student in roster:
        if not (student.email or "").strip():
            raise ValueError(
                f"no email for {student.display_name}"
            )
    name_width = max(
        len(item.display_name) for item in roster
    )
    sect_width = max(len(item.section) for item in roster)
    return [
        f"{item.display_name:<{name_width}}  "
        f"{item.section:<{sect_width}}  "
        f"{item.email.strip()}"
        for item in roster
    ]
